source: Peak memory bandwidth is also a ceiling, not a promise. Effective bandwidth depends on access coalescing, cache behavior, instruction mix, outstanding requests, and other details. ZXNAME0000XZ’s Best Practices Guide recommends measuring effective bandwidth rather than assuming the theoretical specification is achieved.[2]
zh: 峰值内存带宽也是一个上限，而不是一个承诺。有效带宽取决于访问合并、缓存行为、指令混合、未完成的请求和其他详细信息。 ZXNAME0000XZ 的最佳实践指南建议测量有效带宽，而不是假设已达到理论规范。[2]
